title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Colorado State University-Fort Collins
description: Discover the essential late-night food destinations that fuel the Colorado State University community after hours, from iconic toasted subs to local calzone traditions.

cards.title: Cheba Hut "Toasted" Subs
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Sandwiches on Laurel Street
cards.notes: Visit this campus staple for toasted subs and munchies; it stays open until 2:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays to serve the student crowd.
cards.short_summary: A counter-culture themed sandwich shop located directly across from campus on Laurel Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Cheba Hut at 104 E Laurel St is open until Midnight Sunday-Thursday and until 2:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Sandwiches & Sub Shop in Fort Collins 80524 | Cheba Hut
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM on weekends; located on the northern edge of campus.

cards.title: D.P. Dough
cards.subtitle: The Official Late-Night Calzone of the Rams
cards.notes: Order a custom calzone at this student favorite that specializes in late-night delivery and walk-in service until 3:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated calzone shop known for its extensive menu and very late operating hours near CSU.
cards.evidence_claim: D.P. Dough in Fort Collins is an official sponsor of the CSU Rams and offers late-night hours, typically until 3:00 AM on weekends.
cards.source_title: D.P. Dough | Downtown Fort Collins, CO
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM Thursday through Saturday; located on College Avenue.

cards.title: Fat Shack
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Fat Sandwiches and Deep-Fried Treats
cards.notes: Try a signature 'Fat Sandwich' at this College Avenue spot that keeps its kitchen running until 2:10 AM for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant specializing in high-calorie sandwiches and fried desserts, popular for late-night dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Fat Shack at 706 S College Ave has online ordering hours until 2:10 AM.
cards.source_title: Fat Shack 706 South College Avenue - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Kitchen and ordering available until 2:10 AM daily.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Warm Cookie Delivery Until 3:00 AM
cards.notes: Satisfy your sweet tooth with warm cookies delivered to your dorm or picked up in person until 3:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in late-night cookie delivery and walk-in service near the CSU campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies at 646 S College Ave is open until 3:00 AM on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM on weekends and 1:00 AM on weeknights.

cards.title: Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Chicken Finger Meals
cards.notes: Head south on College Avenue for chicken finger combos and signature sauce, with drive-thru service available until 2:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food chain known for its chicken fingers and late-night drive-thru availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's at 2108 S College Ave is open until 2:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Fort Collins, CO, - 2108 S. College Ave
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and dining available until 2:00 AM.

cards.title: Almansita's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Mexican Cuisine
cards.notes: Grab a California burrito or carne asada fries at this local Mexican spot that serves the community until 1:30 AM.
cards.short_summary: A local Mexican restaurant offering a variety of traditional dishes with late-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Almansita's at 2567 S Shields St is open for online ordering and service until 1:25 AM.
cards.source_title: Almansita's 2567 South Shields Street - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:25 AM daily for late-night Mexican food.

cards.title: Silver Mine Subs
cards.subtitle: Mining-Themed Subs Open Until Midnight
cards.notes: Choose from over 20 sandwich options at this local sub shop that offers delivery and dine-in until Midnight daily.
cards.short_summary: A regional sandwich chain with a mining theme, known for late-night delivery and fresh ingredients.
cards.evidence_claim: The Silver Mine Subs location at 4619 S Mason St is open daily until Midnight.
cards.source_title: Order Online in Arizona, Colorado & Wyoming - Silver Mine Subs
cards.access_notes: Open daily until Midnight; delivery available to the CSU area.

cards.title: Ramskeller Pub & Grub
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late-Night Programs
cards.notes: Visit the Lory Student Center for pizza and pub food; check the schedule for late-night programs and live music throughout the year.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus pub and gathering space located in the Lory Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramskeller in the Lory Student Center features late-night programs and live music throughout the academic year.
cards.source_title: Ramskeller - Lory Student Center - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 100 of the LSC; hours vary by event and academic calendar.

cards.title: Waffle House
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Diner Classics
cards.notes: Make the short trip to Mulberry Street for 24-hour breakfast classics like hashbrowns and waffles in a traditional diner setting.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner chain located near the I-25 and Mulberry intersection, serving breakfast and comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waffle House on Mulberry and I-25 is open 24 hours a day.
cards.source_title: Late Night Munchies? Top 5 Fort Collins Restaurants Open Late - 99.9 The Point
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; located approximately 4 miles east of campus.

cards.title: IHOP
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Breakfast on College Avenue
cards.notes: Enjoy pancakes and breakfast platters any time of night at this 24-hour location situated south of the main campus.
cards.short_summary: A well-known breakfast chain offering 24-hour service on the main College Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP on College Avenue in Fort Collins is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Late Night Munchies? Top 5 Fort Collins Restaurants Open Late - 99.9 The Point
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily; located south of campus on College Ave.
